settings.display_mode_help: Choose where the shoutbox appears on the forum.
settings.order_help: Where new messages appear. By default the typing box follows the order and sits next to the newest message, which you can change below.
settings.composer_position_help: Where the box people type in sits. By default it follows the message order, so it is always next to the newest message.
settings.height_help: Height of the messages area in pixels. Default is 320.
settings.poll_interval_help: How often an open shoutbox checks for new messages. Higher values reduce load on a busy forum. Between 10 and 300, default is 30.
settings.cooldown_help: Minimum seconds a user must wait between shouts. Default is 3.
settings.max_rows_help: Older shouts beyond this count are pruned. Default is 500.
